label: Starbucks opens on day 4
description: ROADMAP B4 / S2. Starbucks does not exist on days 1-3; it opens on day 4, the same morning Simffee shifts to 07:00 and a 48k latte (the v1 baseline shock). A full rerun from day 1, so twins whose data made them Starbucks regulars start with no habit for a shop that is not there. Run alongside cf_null as the control arm.
